name: Stremio
layout_summary: Left navigation sidebar: Home, Discover, Library, Calendar, Addons, Settings. Top center: global Search or paste link bar. On media detail pages: poster/synopsis on left, season/episode list or stream source cards in the right-side panel.
avoid_traps: After clicking a movie/series poster, you must select an episode (for series) and then click a specific stream source card on the right panel to start playback.
Do NOT click the top-right window controls when trying to toggle fullscreen — press 'f' inside the video player.

search.primary: smart_type('search bar at top', query, submit=true)
search.visual_fallback: smart_click('Search or paste link bar at top center') -> type_text(query) -> press_key('enter')
search.verify: Search results grid for Movies and Series is displayed

select_episode.primary: smart_click('episode item in right-side panel on details page')
select_episode.visual_fallback: smart_click('Season dropdown at top of right panel')
select_episode.verify: Right panel transitions from episode list to available stream sources

select_stream.primary: smart_click('stream source card on right panel')
select_stream.visual_fallback: smart_click('first 1080p or 4K stream entry on the right panel')
select_stream.verify: Video player opens and begins loading the stream

play_pause.visual_fallback: smart_click('Play or Pause icon at bottom-left of video player')
play_pause.verify: Video playback toggles between playing and paused

fullscreen.visual_fallback: smart_click('Fullscreen icon at bottom-right of video player')

exit_player.visual_fallback: smart_click('Back arrow at top-left of player')
exit_player.verify: Exits fullscreen or returns to the media details page

toggle_subtitles.visual_fallback: smart_click('Subtitles icon on bottom player bar')

audio_tracks.visual_fallback: smart_click('Audio tracks speaker/waveform icon on bottom player bar')

seek_forward.visual_fallback: smart_click('timeline scrubber bar ahead of current position')

seek_backward.visual_fallback: smart_click('timeline scrubber bar behind current position')
